behavior: When `validationMode` is `'blur'`, a required `RadioGroup` with no value is invalid after the focus leaves it. The group or its field needs a `name`. In that mode, a required `Select.Root` with no value is invalid after the focus leaves its trigger, and after an outside press closes its popup. A required `Combobox.Root` with a selection mode and no value, whose trigger is the control, is invalid after the focus leaves its trigger, and after an outside press or a focus that leaves closes its popup. A Combobox whose input is outside the popup keeps the rule of a text field. Base UI shows no error until the form is submitted.
